name: UltraCab
purpose: Guitarix speaker-cabinet simulation (stereo) with built-in microphoned cab sound and controls for the character of the box. Always put it AFTER the amp: an amp without a cabinet sounds thin and fizzy.

params.name: Gain
params.ai_hint: Level into the cabinet model. 0.5 is neutral.

params.name: Mids
params.ai_hint: 0.5 is neutral. Lower for a scooped box, raise for a honky open-back sound.

params.name: Punch
params.ai_hint: Low-end thump from the cabinet. 0.5 is neutral.

params.name: Size
params.ai_hint: Apparent cabinet size. Lower is smaller and brighter, higher bigger and darker.

params.name: Top
params.ai_hint: High-frequency content of the cabinet. Lower for a darker, smoother tone.

notes: Port names and ranges come from the Guitarix plug-in (all 0..1); defaults are the plug-in's own. The upstream size port is SIZE_.
The input is stereo (processed as two channels); a mono guitar through an amp module arrives here as identical channels.
CPU: under 2% of one core at 48 kHz on Plugsalot's 2-core build machine (plugin/tests/TestMain.cpp); 1 point per 2%, minimum 1.
